opening.argument: The video presents an ordinary in-store Ulta shopping trip grounded in concrete purchases, coupon use, and reported checkout results. The speaker selects an Infallible lip product, explains that she will use a $15-off-$50 store coupon with manufacturer coupons, and reports a $38.16 subtotal with $52.25 saved across 11 items. The receipt visibly reflects coupon deductions and the same subtotal. The Ibotta, Fetch Rewards, and Rakuten references are separate referral and cashback promotions tied to stated signup or purchase conditions, not evidence of deception in the shopping or coupon discussion.
